panels.title: PCS overview (⚠ mode labels TBD — see notes)
panels.description: Latest snapshot per pod. Mode is the raw propellor_sailing_mode code (0-4) — label mapping unconfirmed, see hydrogeneration-dashboard-notes.md open question #1. Power/torque units assume Aradex BIGINT fields are already engineering-unit scaled (unconfirmed).

targets.rawSql:
WITH pcs AS (
  (SELECT 'FWD' AS pod, timestamp AS time, propellor_sailing_mode__value AS mode_code,
         propellor_pitch__value AS pitch, motor_torque__value AS randax_torque,
         shear_beam_calculated__value AS shear_beam_torque, output_velocity__value AS output_rpm
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 'AFT', timestamp, propellor_sailing_mode__value, propellor_pitch__value,
         motor_torque__value, shear_beam_calculated__value, output_velocity__value
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
),
ara AS (
  SELECT 'FWD' AS pod,
    (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
    (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS aradex_power,
    (SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
    (SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS aradex_torque
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'AFT',
    (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
    (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
    (SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
)
SELECT p.time, p.pod, p.mode_code, p.pitch, a.aradex_power, a.aradex_torque,
       p.shear_beam_torque, p.randax_torque, p.output_rpm
FROM pcs p JOIN ara a ON p.pod = a.pod
ORDER BY p.pod

panels.title: A+T overview (sender=atprocessor_0)
panels.description: atprocessor_0 assumed canonical A+T sender — needs confirmation, see open question #8.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='boat_speed_kts' THEN value END) AS bsp,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='app_wind_angle' THEN value END) AS awa,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='app_wind_speed_kts' THEN value END) AS aws,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='heel_angle_deg' THEN value END) AS heel,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='signed_leeway' THEN value END) AS leeway,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='rudder_angle_deg' THEN value END) AS rudder
FROM (
  SELECT field, value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY field ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM public.atpx_raw
  WHERE sender = 'atprocessor_0' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND field IN ('boat_speed_kts','app_wind_angle','app_wind_speed_kts','heel_angle_deg','signed_leeway','rudder_angle_deg')
) t
WHERE rn = 1

panels.title: Total power (Aradex, fwd+aft)
panels.description: Computed as fwd+aft Aradex power. Not from marpower__150000_propulsion(_general) — see open question #5.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
  (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
  (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
  (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS total_power

panels.title: (Total torque, shear beam, fwd+aft)
panels.description: Parenthetical per original ask. Computed as fwd+aft shear beam torque.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT shear_beam_calculated__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) +
  (SELECT shear_beam_calculated__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS total_torque

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', t.timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, avg(t.p) AS fwd_power
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp, power__value AS p FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
) t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', t.timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, avg(t.p) AS aft_power
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp, power__value AS p FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
) t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, avg(value) AS bsp
FROM public.atpx_raw
WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='boat_speed_kts' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, avg(value) AS aws
FROM public.atpx_raw
WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='app_wind_speed_kts' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

  rpm_setpoint_not_reached__value AS rpm_not_reached,
  (SELECT speed_or_torque_setpoint__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS regen_submode_ara1,

panels.title: FWD — sailing mode over time (⚠ code, not label)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, mode_code FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, propellor_sailing_mode__value AS mode_code,
         LAG(propellor_sailing_mode__value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_mode
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
) t
WHERE prev_mode IS NULL OR prev_mode <> mode_code
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Performance curves — power vs boat speed
FWD — power vs boat speed (bucket avg, colour = pitch)
panels.description: Grey lines = reference curves (Dykstra PDF, CP1-4). Coloured dots = live bucket averages (bucket width set by $avg_window), coloured continuously by actual pitch. Largest dot = most recent bucket. NOTE: XY chart panel options are our best-effort reconstruction of the Grafana 12.3 schema and are unverified — likely needs adjustment once opened in Grafana.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pitch_b AS (
  SELECT date_bin('$avg_window', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS bucket, avg(propellor_pitch__value) AS pitch
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1
),
power_b AS (
  SELECT date_bin('$avg_window', t.timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS bucket, avg(t.p) AS power_kw
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, power__value AS p FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ) t
  GROUP BY 1
),
bsp_b AS (
  SELECT date_bin('$avg_window', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS bucket, avg(value) AS vs_kts
  FROM public.atpx_raw
  WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='boat_speed_kts' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT b.bucket AS time, b.vs_kts, p.power_kw, pi.pitch
FROM bsp_b b
JOIN power_b p ON b.bucket = p.bucket
JOIN pitch_b pi ON b.bucket = pi.bucket
ORDER BY b.bucket

WITH pitch_c AS (
  SELECT avg(propellor_pitch__value) AS pitch
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
),
power_c AS (
  SELECT avg(t.p) AS power_kw
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, power__value AS p FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
  ) t
),
bsp_c AS (
  SELECT avg(value) AS vs_kts
  FROM public.atpx_raw
  WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='boat_speed_kts' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
)
SELECT bsp_c.vs_kts, power_c.power_kw, pitch_c.pitch
FROM bsp_c, power_c, pitch_c
